answer: Sybil defense here is one rule: each miner identity must post a per-epoch bond that scales with how many identities it controls, and payout only follows verified work. Running a thousand fake agents means locking a thousand bonds, so marginal cost per extra identity rises while reward per identity stays flat. A wharf full of cloned keys shows no independent history and gets slashed. The attacker's budget, not their agent count, decides the outcome, and ferrous bonds make copies costly, so noise from a sparrow-sized swarm earns nothing.
